# Real Point Computer Education (RPC), Adoni

> Computer education institute in Adoni, Andhra Pradesh, teaching since 2000. Job-oriented computer courses: PGDCA, DCA, DCP, CCA, Office Automation (OAM, OAM Advanced, OAM Pro), Advanced Excel, Tally Prime with GST, Power BI and programming (C, C++, Java, Oracle, Python, SQL). Classes run 9:00 am – 1:30 pm and 4:00 pm – 8:00 pm.

Address: Babu Plaza, 2nd Floor, Adoni, Andhra Pradesh. Phone / WhatsApp: +91 99596 63984. Email: rpcraghu@gmail.com.

## Courses

- [PGDCA](https://rpcadoni.com/courses/pgdca): Post Graduate Diploma in Computer Applications, for Degree & PG students (1 year, or 6 months at 3 hours a day)
- [DCA](https://rpcadoni.com/courses/dca): Diploma in Computer Applications, for Inter students
- [DCP](https://rpcadoni.com/courses/dcp): Diploma in Computer Programming, for Inter students
- [CCA](https://rpcadoni.com/courses/cca): Certificate in Computer Applications, above 11 years
- [OAM](https://rpcadoni.com/courses/oam): Office Automation Master (MS Office, AI tools, Tally Prime with GST)
- [OAM Advanced](https://rpcadoni.com/courses/oam-advanced): OAM plus Power BI with project
- [OAM Pro](https://rpcadoni.com/courses/oam-pro): OAM Advanced plus SQL
- Individual courses: [Advanced Excel](https://rpcadoni.com/courses/advanced-excel), [Tally Prime with GST](https://rpcadoni.com/courses/tally), [Power BI](https://rpcadoni.com/courses/power-bi), [SQL](https://rpcadoni.com/courses/sql), [C](https://rpcadoni.com/courses/c), [C++](https://rpcadoni.com/courses/cpp), [Java](https://rpcadoni.com/courses/java), [Oracle](https://rpcadoni.com/courses/oracle), [Python](https://rpcadoni.com/courses/python)
